source_owned_lookup_adapter:
def native_lookup(arm,common,raw,plan,items):
    cpu,_,provider=machine(arm,common,raw,plan)
    instruction = struct.unpack_from('<I', arm, CALLS[0])[0]
    assert instruction >> 24 == 0xEB
    delta = (instruction & 0xFFFFFF) << 2
    if delta & 0x2000000:
        delta -= 0x4000000
    entry = BASE + CALLS[0] + 8 + delta
    results=[]
    for item in items:
        body=bytes.fromhex(item['stored_hex'])[0 if item.get('virtual_prefix_not_stored') else 1:]
        pointer = 0x02468020
        cpu.mem_write(pointer - 16, b'\xa5' * (len(body) + 33))
        cpu.mem_write(pointer, body + b'\0')
        before = bytes(cpu.mem_read(pointer - 16, len(body) + 33))
        memory_before=bytes(cpu.mem_read(BASE,len(raw)))
        cpu.reg_write(UC_ARM_REG_R1, pointer)
        cpu.reg_write(UC_ARM_REG_LR, BASE + CALLS[0] + 4)
        cpu.reg_write(UC_ARM_REG_SP, 0x027F0000)
        stack=cpu.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_SP)
        cpu.emu_start(entry, MACRO, count=1000000)
        assert cpu.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_SP)==stack
        assert cpu.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_PC) == MACRO
        selected = cpu.reg_read(UC_ARM_REG_R1)
        target = bytes(cpu.mem_read(selected, 1024)).split(b'\0')[0]
        assert len(target) < 1024 and bytes(cpu.mem_read(pointer - 16, len(body) + 33)) == before
        assert bytes(cpu.mem_read(BASE,len(raw)))==memory_before and target==body
        results.append(dict(id=item['id'],stored_body_hex=body.hex(),target_hex=target.hex(),selected_pointer=selected,input_pointer=pointer,all_unowned4MiB_SP_andinput_canaries_exact=True,complete_effective_body_equals_new_stored_body=True))
    return results
